key_points: JD Sports Fashion received a Hold rating from Shore Capital Group (neutral).
Insider bought 320,000 shares of JD Sports Fashion, signaling confidence.
JD.com options activity indicates renewed trader interest and possible turnaround speculation.
Nike's reduction of China online distributors may benefit domestic e-commerce platforms like JD.com.
UK media criticized JD Sports shares as unattractive compared to other FTSE 100 stocks.
